correctness.rationale: A strong induction on semilength uses the unique Dyck first-return decomposition and the hereditary nature of factor avoidance; every excluded component pair contains an explicitly identified forbidden antisquare of order at least 2. The only candidates have four runs with singleton interior runs and cannot contain two-run or three-run antisquares of order at least two. Brute-force independent enumeration of all 290,511 nonempty Dyck words through semilength 12 agrees, without being treated as infinite proof.
